source: Ravages lore document (campaign lore supplied by the user, 23 October 2026); positions in source map pixels (2000 x 926): named places from data/places.csv / places_labels.csv, regions as the mean of their hexes in the campaign sheet

cores.name: Aēnaha
cores.why: capital of the Sémih Kingdom at the Ayauda estuary, conquered by Avesta in year 0 and the Empire's capital since

cores.name: Kāma Basin
cores.why: where the Mahistva, the people who founded the Empire, settled; later a network of Arǧosi allies

cores.name: Arǧos
cores.why: the Kingdom of Arǧos was born in its name-sake city on the western slopes of the great eastern massif

cores.name: Hyavā Shore
cores.why: the Ekiari Empire's south-western coast; its city-states (the Suzerainty) are the mercantile heart, as under the Ekiari

cores.name: Kaŕko Plain
cores.why: the new heart of the Ekiari imperium in its second half; Lasiŕos, the largest realm, has fertile lands and a big population

cores.name: Arsi Negele
cores.why: the Tarani kingdom's ancient capital, from which its rulers' ancestors spread civilisation

cores.name: Nisāyan Peninsula
cores.why: a confederation of cities that once ruled every shore of Nisāya's Sea
